news.title: CommBank Junior Matildas Squad Update: 22nd October 2026
news.lede: CommBank Junior Matildas goalkeeper Alyse Oppedisano has sustained an anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) injury during training and will take no further part in the FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup. With the continued support of Football Australia and Sydney FC, Oppedisano will depart camp to commence her rehabilitation, with her focus now turning to the road ahead. We wish Alyse all the very best in her recovery. "I’m disappointed that my tournament has come to an end, but I’m proud to have been part of this group.

news.title: Delhi police to replace all football players in a bid to win World Cup
news.lede: The Delhi police’s aggressive work tackling the protests against vote chori has earned them well-deserved rewards, not just promotions. To win the next World Cup, the Football Association of India has decided to replace all players with Delhi police personnel. The association took the unanimous decision despite all committee members voting against it. The House Minister, who also holds the additional charge of kicking, backed the decision he forced upon the association.
